item.title: Born again – Mazda’s CX-5 lives on | cars4starters
item.description: With the rollout of its CX-60, CX-70, CX-80 and CX-90, all of them hybrids, it wasn't looking too good for Mazda's best-selling but cheaper CX-5 -- but, the CX-5 is about to enter it’s third generation.

item.title: Kia K4 Hatch: Where’s the hybrid? | cars4starters
item.description: Kia has not forgotten buyers who don't want an EV, with the launch of the petrol-powered K4 Hatch, and not even a hybrid in sight, reports DEREK OGDEN.

item.title: Leapmotor adds powerhouse C10 Special Edition | cars4starters
item.description: Leapmotor's 440kW C10 Special Edition could turn a few heads when it arrives later this month.

item.title: Mille Miglia — I See Red, Red, Red | cars4starters
item.description: The Mille Miglia is a must for any petrol head. You can sit and watch the money whizz by, reports BARRY GREEN.

item.title: Electric Hilux ready to roll | cars4starters
item.description: The past and future will collide when Toyota’s first-ever fully-electric Hilux goes on sale next month.

item.title: Mitsubishi Outlander: Competition the thing | cars4starters
item.description: Mitsubishi's Outlander is a lot of car and it needs to be because of the growing number of often cheaper competitors, reports CHRIS RILEY.

item.title: The Nissan Z for collectors | cars4starters
item.description: Once upon a time purple was the colour of choice for hotted up Aussie Valiants, but that's the colour Nissan Australia has selected for its Nissan Z Heritage Edition.

item.title: Secret Holdens we didn’t see | cars4starters
item.description: DAVID BURRELL takes us behind the scenes for a look at what might have been for Holden, with the secret prototypes that didn't make it.

item.title: Contessa first Japanese car to taste victory overseas | cars4starters
item.description: The Hino Contessa was the first Japanese car to win a race outside its home country, reports BILL BUYS.

item.title: Pre-loved: Honda City 2010-2020 | cars4starters
item.description: With a big boot and plenty of rear legroom, the Honda City has usually led a sheltered life and is overlooked by secondhand buyers, reports EWAN KENNEDY.
